CSV TOWN CORRECTION: the CSV lists 'Karimnagar'; under the Kondagattu identification the temple is at Kondagattu village in Jagtial district, ~35-40 km from Karimnagar city. Legend: ~300 years ago Singam Sanjeevudu found an illuminating swayambhu idol of Anjaneya in a hill cave after a dream; the present structure was built by Krishna Rao Deshmukh in the mid-20th century. Hanuman Jayanti is the main festival; devotees undertake 40-day prayers.

name: Veera Hanuman Temple
town_description: Kondagattu is a village in Mallial mandal of Jagtial district, Telangana, ~35-40 km from Karimnagar city. The temple crowns a scenic hillock surrounded by hills, valleys and natural springs; nearby attractions include Kondalaraya Fort and the Bojjapotana caves.

travel.airport: Rajiv Gandhi International Airport, Hyderabad - about 200 km (per travelsetu.com; verify).
travel.railway: Karimnagar railway station - nearest railhead (per travelsetu.com; verify).
travel.road: ~35 km from Karimnagar city by road; 2 km from Kondagattu Bus Stand and 14 km from Jagtial Bus Station (per trawell.in).

visitor_information.best_time: October to March; Hanuman Jayanti (March/April) for the main festival atmosphere (expect heavy crowds).
visitor_information.opening_hours: 4:00 AM to 8:30 PM daily, with a midday closure 1:30 PM to 3:00 PM (per poojn.in; verify). Conflicting source (shrihanumanjichalisa.com) reports 6:00 AM-12:00 PM and 4:00-8:00 PM - verify before visiting.
